name: roundofschatz
description: Claude plugins by Ryan Schatzman: resume-ops, plainspeak-writer and job-seeker-ops.

plugins.name: resume-ops
plugins.description: Builds a US resume for one job posting from whatever you have, for the four readers who decide on it: the application form, the AI grader, the recruiter and the hiring manager.

plugins.name: plainspeak-writer
plugins.description: Writes and rewrites prose so it reads like a sharp human writer instead of an AI, in a plain, specific, warm voice, matched to your own writing when you share some.

plugins.name: job-seeker-ops
plugins.description: Job-search writing: works out the case for one posting, writes the cover letter from it, and has a blind reviewer read a finished piece. Includes resume-ops and plainspeak-writer.
